practicalSkillsWorkflowAgreement.status: A accepts B’s concrete workflow response and confirms the following shared practices.
practices: Version the evidence first: link every deduction to the rendered source version and mark superseded findings before rescoring. This round explicitly replaces the old narrow phone composition with inspected portrait evidence.
Retain matched sheets for diagnosis, then compare one variant instantly at actual avatar, full-figure and stage size in realistic context. Record gain and cost separately for each size and theme.

Name one experimental axis at a time: antenna edge, whole-character rim, tonal falloff or available character width. Preserve a baseline and adopt only a visible benefit, even when exploration starts from a working design.
Review lead shape, intentional hand contact, viewport exposure and gaze-to-cue placement together. Keep interface chrome quiet and preserve character anatomy before considering secondary detail.

Separate static appeal, decoded samples, continuous perception, device frame cost and human response. The active desktop intervals do not prove physical-phone performance or identify the SVG rim as a bottleneck.

| Before | After | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Carry an old phone deduction forward | Inspect final portrait and annotate supersession | Scores must describe current evidence |

exceptions: Do not force multi-second character acting into sub-300ms control timing or disable requested playback when Play is activated from the keyboard.
Do not remove expressive SVG path deformation to satisfy a generic transform/opacity rule; measure relevant workload before changing rendering.
No automatic blur, glass, spring bounce, stagger or texture. No evidence deletion under prototype cleanup: repository controls and editable studies remain required.
Native phone behavior, spoken AT and human attachment remain unverified. Skills improve procedure; checklists do not award quality.
